name: CASBOT 02
summary:
CASBOT 02 is a full-size bipedal humanoid designed for interactive services, demonstrations and embodied-intelligence development. It combines articulated arms and legs with RGB-D vision, microphones and voice interaction. CASBOT describes imitation-learning and reinforcement-learning controls for adapting its balance and gait to different surfaces.

The official specification lists a height of 1.63 metres and a standard-model weight of approximately 50 kg. Standard and EDU configurations differ: the EDU model adds development support, additional perception hardware and navigation capabilities

description.en:
CASBOT 02 is a full-size bipedal humanoid designed for interactive services, demonstrations and embodied-intelligence development. It combines articulated arms and legs with RGB-D vision, microphones and voice interaction. CASBOT describes imitation-learning and reinforcement-learning controls for adapting its balance and gait to different surfaces.

The official specification lists a height of 1.63 metres and a standard-model weight of approximately 50 kg. Standard and EDU configurations differ: the EDU model adds development support, additional perception hardware and navigation capabilities. The modular architecture allows sensors and joint configurations to be adapted to the intended application.
